branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A lactic acid bacteria drink made by Nissin York in Japan, containing Lactobacillus paracasei NY1301. It is a FOSHU (Foods for Specified Health Uses) product.

sources.text: The maker, the strain and its FOSHU status, from this article.
